title: What's new in v2.5.3
summary: Uptime on the ISP Health score card, and outages scored against the window you are looking at.

steps.title: Uptime
steps.listLabel: Outages scored against the window, not in flat minutes
steps.body: **Uptime** now sits above the three gauges. Outages are scored against the window you are looking at, so fifteen minutes down costs far less over a month than over a day.
